title: workflow speed: hermetic temp under target, nextest parallelism, release builds overlap the suite
goal: Bring the local gate and the release pipeline down from tens of minutes to minutes: hermetic test homes live under the excluded shared target, nextest runs more threads with reservations for the process-spawning tests, release legs build in parallel with the suite and publish only after it passes, the dist profile links with thin LTO, and a release reuses an in-flight main run instead of dispatching a duplicate.
